lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਸਭਨਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa maranaa aaiaa vechhoRaa sabhanaah ||
lines.translation: Death comes to all, and all must suffer separation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਆਣਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਕਿਨਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: puchhahu jaai siaaniaa aagai milan kinaah ||
lines.translation: Go and ask the clever people, whether they shall meet in the world hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਵਡੜੀ ਵੇਦਨ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin meraa saahib veesarai vadaRee vedan tinaah ||1||
lines.translation: Those who forget my Lord and Master shall suffer in terrible pain. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhee saalaahihu saachaa soi ||
lines.translation: So praise the True Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee nadar sadaa sukh hoi || rahaau ||
lines.translation: by whose Grace peace ever prevails. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaa kar saalaahanaa hai bhee hosee soi ||
lines.translation: Praise Him as great; He is, and He shall ever be.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਮਾਣਸ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa daataa ek too maanas daat na hoi ||
lines.translation: You alone are the Great Giver; mankind cannot give anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਰੰਨ ਕਿ ਰੁੰਨੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai ra(n)n k ru(n)nai hoi ||2||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; what good does it do to cry out in protest? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਕੋਟ ਗੜ ਕੇਤੀ ਗਈ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharatee upar kot gaR ketee gaee vajaai ||
lines.translation: Many have proclaimed their sovereignty over millions of fortresses on the earth, but they have now departed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ਨ ਮਾਵਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਨਕਿ ਨਥਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo asamaan na maavanee tin nak nathaa paai ||
lines.translation: And those, whom even the sky could not contain, had ropes put through their noses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੂਲੀਆ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਿਠਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je man jaanahi sooleeaa kaahe mithaa khaahi ||3||
lines.translation: O mind, if you only knew the torment in your future, you would not relish the sweet pleasures of the present. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਗਲੀ ਜੰਜੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak augun jetaRe tete galee ja(n)jeer ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, as many as are the sins one commits, so many are the chains around his neck.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਨਿ ਤ ਕਟੀਅਨਿ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਵੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: je gun hon ta kateean se bhaaee se veer ||
lines.translation: If he possesses virtues, then the chains are cut away; these virtues are his brothers, his true brothers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਗਏ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਹੁ ਵੇਪੀਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: agai gae na ma(n)neean maar kadhahu vepeer ||4||1||
lines.translation: Going to the world hereafter, those who have no Guru are not accepted; they are beaten, and expelled. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਾਲੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man haalee kirasaanee karanee saram paanee tan khet ||
lines.translation: Make your mind the farmer, good deeds the farm, modesty the water, and your body the field.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਾ ਰਖੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam beej sa(n)tokh suhaagaa rakh gareebee ves ||
lines.translation: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, contentment the plow, and your humble dress the fence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਮਸੀ ਸੇ ਘਰ ਭਾਗਠ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhaau karam kar ja(n)masee se ghar bhaagath dekh ||1||
lines.translation: Doing deeds of love, the seed shall sprout, and you shall see your home flourish. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa maaiaa saath na hoi ||
lines.translation: O Baba, the wealth of Maya does not go with anyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: in maaiaa jag mohiaa viralaa boojhai koi || rahaau ||
lines.translation: This Maya has bewitched the world, but only a rare few understand this. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਣੁ ਹਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਜਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: haan hat kar aarajaa sach naam kar vath ||
lines.translation: Make your ever-decreasing life your shop, and make the Lord's Name your merchandise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਂਡਸਾਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: surat soch kar bhaa(n)dasaal tis vich tis no rakh ||
lines.translation: Make understanding and contemplation your warehouse, and in that warehouse, store the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਨ ਹਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vanajaariaa siu vanaj kar lai laahaa man has ||2||
lines.translation: Deal with the Lord's dealers, earn your profits, and rejoice in your mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ ਸਤੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਲੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun saasat saudaagaree sat ghoRe lai chal ||
lines.translation: Let your trade be listening to scripture, and let Truth be the horses you take to sell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਰਚੁ ਬੰਨੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kharach ba(n)n cha(n)giaaeeaa mat man jaanahi kal ||
lines.translation: Gather up merits for your travelling expenses, and do not think of tomorrow in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nira(n)kaar kai des jaahi taa sukh lahahi mahal ||3||
lines.translation: When you arrive in the land of the Formless Lord, you shall find peace in the Mansion of His Presence. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: laai chit kar chaakaree ma(n)n naam kar ka(n)m ||
lines.translation: Let your service be the focusing of your consciousness, and let your occupation be the placing of faith in the Naam.
